event.title: China Unveils Advanced Humanoid Robots Amid US Trade Restrictions
event.canonical_title: China Unveils Advanced Humanoid Robots Amid US Trade Restrictions
event.summary: During the World Robot Conference held in Beijing on August 19, over 300 companies showcased a variety of humanoid, industrial, and service robots. This event underscores the robotics sector's increasing integration into factories and commercial environments, particularly in light of US trade restrictions affecting firms operating abroad.

timeline.title: Chinese Humanoid Robots Break Human Records in Sprint and High Jump at Beijing Games
timeline.summary: At the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, Chinese humanoid robots set new records by outperforming human athletes. One robot, named 'Lightning,' completed a 100-meter sprint in 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's world record. Additionally, robots excelled in the high jump, further showcasing advancements in humanoid robotics.
key_facts: Chinese humanoid robots competed in the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.
The robot 'Lightning' ran 100 meters in 9.39 seconds, breaking Usain Bolt's record.
Robots also set records in the high jump.
